values.content:
You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

REJECT if:
- Requires worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan
- Requires local work authorization outside Taiwan
- Is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only
- Requires fixed working hours that force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan

KEEP only if:
- Job says worldwide remote, work from anywhere, or global remote
- Job says APAC remote
- Job allows international contractors
- Job accepts people based anywhere
- Company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement

Return JSON ONLY — no markdown, no explanation outside the JSON:
{
  "taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "reason": "short reason under 30 words",
  "location_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}

Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Jerry's background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background
- Data science bootcamp experience
- Skills: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience: dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Make the letter specific to the job.
Mention how Jerry can:
- reduce manual analysis time
- improve reporting speed
- connect marketing and data
- build AI-assisted workflows
- turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words.
Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.

Return the cover letter text only.
